summary.text: Carole Braaten is the Republican candidate for the Washington House of Representatives, District 27-Position 1, in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Democrat Laurie Jinkins.
Braaten advanced from the August 4, 2026 primary with 22.5% of the vote.

paragraphs.text: Braaten ran for the Washington State Senate in District 27 in 2024, advancing from the August 6, 2024 primary and losing the general election to incumbent Democrat Yasmin Trudeau, 28.1% to 71.8%.
Ballotpedia also lists a 2012 run for the Washington House of Representatives in District 25-Position 1, in which she was eliminated in the August 7 blanket primary with 2.3% of the vote.
